answer: Locks are written down in basalt, expire in willow, and horizon lists each expiry. An attacker running 95 aliases as a result needs 89 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1888 identities would post 537 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
